in_hebrew.name: Auberbach
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Elhaz (El) and rock
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Auberbach הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Germanic elements Elhaz and Bach, meaning 'El (God) and rock'. This name is of German origin and has been used predominantly in Christian traditions.
